name: Miyasaka Noriko
source:
The current head of the Miyasaka family, who has the most influence in the village.
Noriko often has errands outside the village and is away from her family when the first fatal incident occurs. 

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20010625112432fw_/http://www.din.or.jp/~syscom/ange/new/eternity/index.html]official website[/url].]
